purpose: Handbook page listing all start arguments and environment variables.
details: Part of it is generated by docs/tools/handleiding.py (the table of arguments comes from the argparse parser in leeravontuur/__main__.py); a test checks every argument is present. Includes display arguments (valid for one run only), commands that stop at once, and environment variables for advanced users such as LEERAVONTUUR_DATA.
summary: Lists every start argument (colour-blind, contrast, no colour, ascii, no mouse, no clock window, --ouder, --wachtwoord-vergeten, --snelkoppeling, --fouten, --debug, --test, --versie), explains which are for one run only, and documents environment variables like LEERAVONTUUR_DATA.
